component.name: Bigify
component.summary: Spotify Connect player for TVs and Steam Deck

description.p: Bigify is a full-screen music player designed for the living room: big type, large artwork and controller-first navigation. It plays music through Spotify Connect and can be signed in from the Spotify app on your phone without typing on the TV.

ul.li: Home, Search, Library, artist, album and playlist pages
Expressive Now Playing screen with colors from the album art
Full game controller support, including Steam Deck
Media keys and desktop media controls (MPRIS)

description.p: Requires Spotify Premium. Bigify is an independent open-source project and is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Spotify.

Library items can be selected with a controller again; search results no longer cut off the focus outline, and Y (or Tab) jumps from the keyboard to the results; the Now Playing backdrop fills the screen; songs in Up next can be played directly; L2/R2 (LT/RT) skip 10 seconds back and forward; volume is shown as a brief indicator instead of on-screen controls.

Fixes Search and Library failing with "unexpected response" for playlists; lyrics from LRCLIB in Now Playing; immersive Now Playing that hides the controls when idle; focus outline no longer cut off at the top of track lists.
Home, Search and Library work again through a one-time library access setup with your own Spotify app, because Spotify rate-limits third-party use of its built-in access.

Fixes library, playlists and search failing with "can't reach Spotify"; on-screen hints now match your controller or keyboard; navigation rail with logo and Playing/Settings at the bottom; cleaner progress bar in the mini player.
